study: NON-SYMMETRIC strict-h0 K=4 CRRA REE contour-Phi fixed-point study with VERY HETEROGENEOUS per-agent tau and gamma

method.full_block: FULL 4D inner block G_inner^4 = 6561 unknowns at G_inner=9 (NO multiset reduction; heterogeneity breaks permutation symmetry so price is not symmetric)
method.operator: phi_K4_halo / init_no_learning_halo (Numba, per-agent tau_vec/gamma_vec/W_vec); contour evidence = 2D-plane integral over 3-other-agents level set (3 axis-projections averaged), preserved as-is
method.solver: scipy newton_krylov (lgmres) on the inner block, multi-seed; undamped Picard for the oscillation test
method.fr_het_benchmark: P_FR_het = lam(sum_i tau_i u_i) (precision-weighted aggregate); het-deficit = 1 - R^2 of logit(P) regressed on sum_i tau_i u_i (metrics.revelation_deficit already uses tau_vec, so it is the het deficit; independently cross-checked)

primary.note: tau 10x spread, gamma 80x spread; in this config the best-informed agent (tau=5) is also the most risk-averse (gamma=4)

anti.note: ANTI-aligned: best-informed agent (tau=5) is the most aggressive/risk-neutral (gamma=0.05); secondary config

verdict.nk_note: No seed reaches Finf<1e-2 (non-smooth contour floor, as in homogeneous K=4). FR-het seed keeps the LOWEST deficit (~0.04 under NK); off-FR seeds stall at PR (0.10-0.20).
verdict.verdict_text: VERDICT: VERY-HETEROGENEOUS tau=[0.5,1,2,5] (10x), gamma=[0.05,0.25,1,4] (80x) does NOT reintroduce the K=3 partial-revelation/oscillation structure. (1) The equilibrium is FULLY REVEALING of the precision-weighted aggregate sum_i tau_i u_i: undamped Picard from the no-learning IC drives the het-deficit 0.352 -> 0.0062 (essentially FR; min 0.0062), and Picard started AT the exact het-FR price STAYS at deficit 0.0056 (does not drift to PR). NK confirms: the FR-het seed keeps the lowest deficit (~0.04), off-FR seeds merely stall at PR (0.10-0.20, never converging). (2) NO period-2 oscillation (period2=False); the residual settles to a NON-SMOOTH floor ~0.0268 (contour-crossing non-differentiability), the same artifact homogeneous K=4 showed. CONCLUSION: like homogeneous K=4 (-> FR, no osc, deficit ~0), K=4 stays FULLY-REVEALING and STABLE even with very different agents -- it does NOT revert to the homogeneous-K=3 regime (unique PR eq, deficit ~0.27, period-2 learning oscillation). Heterogeneity in tau/gamma is absorbed by the precision-weighted sufficient statistic, not converted into information loss or instability.

comparison.homogeneous_K4: unique FR equilibrium (deficit ~0), no period-2 oscillation, non-smooth residual floor ~0.015
comparison.homogeneous_K3: unique PARTIALLY-REVEALING equilibrium (deficit ~0.27), period-2 learning oscillation
comparison.heterogeneous_K4_primary: FR/near-FR equilibrium (Picard-from-NL deficit -> 0.0062), NO period-2 oscillation, non-smooth residual floor ~0.0268 -- matches homogeneous K=4, NOT K=3
